note: Structural event flow edits for the gated flow locations of data/flow_locations.json. They run only when the location receives an item other than its vanilla one, after the ordinary parameter edits of that location. $item stands for the chosen item actor. The specs of the always list run in every seed build whatever is placed, they hold the magic gauge edits that follow from only the Magic Meter items giving a meter and the edits that open the fountains and the summit owl without Din's Fire. The locations join the pool only with shuffle_rewards=supported and shuffle_rewards_extra on. Design and evidence in docs/flow_checks.md sections 3, 4 and 8, build notes in docs/flow_checks_built_2.md.

locations.name: DMC Great Fairy Reward
locations.why: the Wisdom gift sub plays the double magic gauge birth after the item (events 75 to 78 of Dm_SY_GetInEvent) whatever the item is, only the magic meter items can create that gauge, so another item is handed over with the plain fountain gift sub that the other fountains use. A returning visit asks IsGet.Item_FairyBless_MPDouble (event 4) and while it is false offers the gift again, a shuffled gift never sets it, so the check reads a spare persistent flag that is set right after the gift

locations.name: Market Potion Shop Free Bottle
locations.why: the tutorial bars the shop door until the escaped bug is caught, and the bug needs an empty bottle, so with another item in place of the gift the offer first asks for an empty bottle: the per talk flag check of event 16 becomes that pouch check, with one the flow runs the vanilla offer and tutorial unchanged except the first talk lines, without one the keeper says the shop opens soon (event 62) and nothing is given or started

locations.name: Market Potion Shop Red Potion
locations.why: the bug reward pours the Red Potion into the equipped bottle, so another item is handed over with the plain NPC gift sub, the same call Malon uses for the Weird Egg, and the tutorial still ends with the Cleared flag that opens the shop

always.name: Din fountain gauge
always.why: Din's Fire no longer carries the magic meter, so the Din gift sub must never be told the player had no magic (GreatFairy_HasNoMPOnDinDemo, set by event 579 when PlayerStatus.MPMax is 0), that flag makes the sub play the gauge birth for a gauge that Din's Fire cannot create, both cases of the check go to event 42 whatever the gift is and the flag is never set

always.name: Fire Arrow pickup gauge
always.why: the pickup of the Fire Arrows (the one actor with the Obj_Fire_Arrow tag, case 1 of the tag check) plays the MPOpen gauge birth when PlayerStatus.MPMax is 0, Fire Arrows no longer carry the magic meter, so both cases of the check in event 176 end in the 30 frame wait of event 180 and no gauge is born

always.name: Doubled magic without the improved spin
always.why: pots, rocks, grass, flying pots and skulltulas drop a fixed tier, so a doubled magic drop picked up out of order would leave the Gift of Improved Spin missing for good. Right after a pickup puts itself in the pouch (event 7, AddOwnToPouch, before event 183 picks the gauge birth) a player who holds Item_FairyBless_MPDouble but not Item_FairyBless_MP gets the first gift, then the doubled magic again in case the first gift lowered the bar, both handed over as a chest does

always.name: Fairy fountains without Din's Fire
always.why: after Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce mark every fountain but the Din one asks IsGet.Item_DinFire (event 3 of TriForcePoint, shared by all six fountains) and without the spell Navi gives a hint and the fountain stays shut, the fountains are free from the start, so the no case also goes to event 57, the riddle sound and the transition to the fountain

always.name: Summit owl without Din's Fire
always.why: the Death Mountain summit owl asks IsGet.Item_DinFire (event 3) and without the spell only talks about the fairy behind the rock, the ride is free from the start, so the no case also goes to event 12, the talk that offers the ride to Kakariko

always.name: Fortress gatekeeper keeps the Spirit quest step
always.why: the gatekeeper's first talk as a member (event 31 marks the talk, event 4 asks the SageOfSpirit quest for Step02) would skip the carpenter rescue for a player who is a member through the Gerudo Card alone, the rescue already moves the quest to Step02, so event 31 goes straight to event 87 and the gate still opens
